method.exact: case-fold text and collapse whitespace, then match identical normalized full reports across different user_id values
method.near: 5-word shingle 64-bit SimHash; four 16-bit locality-sensitive bands generate candidate pairs; verify distinct-author pairs by shingle-set Jaccard >= 0.85
method.note: LSH candidate generation is approximate and may miss some near duplicates; reports are not published.
